title: General-Purpose Technologies and Stock Market Bubbles
abstract: arXiv:2501.08215v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We develop a macro-finance model linking stock price bubbles to a general-purpose technology (GPT), such as information technology and artificial intelligence. Knowledge spillovers differ across production factors, generating unbalanced growth and causing stock prices to outgrow dividends. Under our conditions, the unique equilibrium contains a bubble on dividend-paying stocks even though agents share common beliefs and rationally anticipate its collapse. The probability that spillovers persist affects the bubble's duration but not its existence. When spillovers equalize as the technology matures, the economy reaches balanced growth and the bubble collapses. Through IPO proceeds, the bubble can increase R\&D employment, while accumulated knowledge remains productive afterward. translated_title: 通用目的技术与股市泡沫
translated_abstract: arXiv:2501.08215v3 公告类型：替换 摘要：我们构建了一个宏观金融模型，将股票价格泡沫与通用目的技术（如信息技术和人工智能）联系起来。知识溢出在不同生产要素间存在差异，导致非平衡增长，并使股票价格增长超过股息。在我们的条件下，即使代理人拥有共同信念并理性预期其崩溃，唯一均衡仍包含股息支付股票上的泡沫。溢出持续存在的概率影响泡沫持续时间，但不影响其存在性。当技术成熟使溢出趋于均衡时，经济达到平衡增长，泡沫崩溃。通过IPO收益，泡沫可以增加研发就业，而积累的知识在此后仍具生产力。更广泛地说，平衡增长是一种刀刃性质：用于实现它的限制条件使股票价格和股息以相同速率增长，从而排除了泡沫的存在。
tldr: 本文提出一个宏观金融模型，证明在通用目的技术（如信息技术和AI）下，即使理性预期，股息支付股票仍可出现泡沫，泡沫通过IPO促进研发，但技术成熟时泡沫崩溃。
en_tdlr: This paper develops a macro-finance model showing that bubbles on dividend-paying stocks can arise under rational expectations with general-purpose technologies (e.g., IT and AI), boosting R&D via IPOs, but collapse as technology matures.
